{"path":"/Deep Research App/start","args":{"user_query":"ADDITIONAL INSTRUCTION FROM THE GMRI INVESTIGATOR — APPLY TO THE ACTIVE DEEP RESEARCH SESSION AND ITS EXISTING FULL CORRECTIVE RECOVERY DIRECTIVE, WITHOUT REPLACING OR CONDENSING THE OTHER REQUIREMENTS.

VERBATIM USER ADDENDUM:
“Instruction addendum: Do not partially read documents. There is no such thing as a load-bearing argument when you do not read a complete document.”

Execution implication: For every document used as research evidence or a basis for conclusions, read the COMPLETE document before analyzing, synthesizing, or citing it. Do not rely on selected passages, excerpts, abstracts, summaries, snippets, or purported 'load-bearing' sections as substitutes for complete reading. Revisit any document previously partially read. In the current plan, a status of 'completed' based on a document being opened or its reading merely begun is NOT completion: correct such statuses and the source-coverage record accordingly. If complete access is unavailable, explicitly mark the document not fully read, disclose the gap, and do not claim completion, comprehensive analysis, or authoritative interpretation of that document. Preserve the investigator's original addendum word for word in the updated research plan."}}

Your addendum has been sent to the active Deep Research session **verbatim**, with instructions to update its research plan.

It specifically requires complete-document reading and reopens any work previously marked complete on the basis of partial reading.

Deep Research will incorporate the correction and continue the investigation.
Not yet. Everybody made the mistake of waiting until, well, wood stopped. They learned.
